thread:
maya r: dropped a tiny prototype for pin leases vs demote hints. want quick sanity check before RFC.

david l: nice. what's the failure mode? pins forgotten = leaked GPU memory right?

maya r: exactly. design is explicit lease: pin(range_ids, owner, ttl_ms) -> lease_id. renew(lease_id) and release(lease_id). allocator enforces ttl expiry and exposes leaked_lease metric.

ines p: how to avoid too many round trips for small inferences?

maya r: add batch endpoints: hint_batch([{range, tier}]) and a coalesced lease return. runtime will batch per-request.

david l: fragmentation visibility? if demoting causes holes we should surface a frag_score so scheduler can decide compaction vs recompute.

maya r: agreed. frag_score(range_ids)=low|med|high and compaction_est_ms. not exact but useful for heuristics.

ines p: latency-sensitive requests may need a fast path. propose pin_fast(range) -> {OK, PENDING, FALLBACK} so caller can immediately choose quantize/fallback.

compactor-bot: canary perf: background compactor processed ~38k pages/s; compaction windows correlated with tenant spikes; p99 tail +9% during compaction.

david l: so compaction must be coordinated with scheduler. add compaction_allowed boolean gated by global free pages metric and per-tenant rate limits.

maya r: will draft RFC with these primitives + telemetry (leak counters, compaction events, migrate_cost hints). will include example scheduler flows and canary plan. ping me for reviews. end thread.
